item.title: Japan to hold council on Futenma base issues by year-end
item.description: The council for promoting the alleviation of burdens from the Futenma base, has not met since April 2019.

item.title: Japan death-row inmate in 1970s corporate bombings dies
item.description: Masunaga, a member of the East Asia Anti-Japan Armed Front, had been undergoing treatment for a cerebral infarction. The cause of death was unclear.

item.title: Left in limbo: What happens to foreign spouses in Japan when a marriage ends
item.description: Thousands of foreign nationals are allowed to live in Japan because of their marriage certificates. Here's what happens if the marriage ends.

item.title: Japan eyes December launch for system that checks for sex offense records
item.description: The law also requires measures to prevent sexual violence before it occurs, in order to address concerns among children and their parents.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
